description: The content hash of every scenarios.json row, by id@version: sha256 of the row as canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace). An entry is never changed or removed; node tools/t3cp/scenarios-check.mjs --lock adds the entries of new rows. Retiring a row is not an edit: its status alone goes from active to retired, never back, and its entry stays the hash of the row as it was locked.
